g:HTMLPanel.p: Checkboxes, radios, ranges, file and color inputs, and multiple selects.

d:Example.heading: Checkboxes
d:Example.description: `value="true"` checks the box; `reverse` puts the box after the label.

d:Example.heading: Radios
d:Example.description: Radios with the same `name` form a group: checking one unchecks the others.

d:Example.heading: Range
d:Example.description: `InputRange` is a native slider; `min` and `max` bound it.

d:Example.heading: File and color
d:Example.description: `InputFile` picks files; `InputColor` is the browser's color picker.

d:Example.heading: Multiple select
d:Example.description: `multipleSelect` lets the user pick several options; `visibleItemCount` sets the height.
